item.title: Guide To Debloating Windows
item.description:
A Simple Guide to Debloating Windows

Windows comes with with a bunch of extra apps, background tracking that is effectively spyware, and features nobody wants or asked for (like copilot). I’ll show you how to remove a majority of the junk Windows comes with to reduce data collection, remove clutter, and very likely speed up your computer. I always run this on any new installation of Windows 10/11, but that isn’t required for this process to work. If you want to stay on Windows 10, you can use 0Patch to stay up to date with security updates even after Microsoft kills off W10 on October 14th, 2025.
